{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (sentinel for missing age)
df_valid = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age on valid data
mean_age = df_valid['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Number of valid age entries: {len(df_valid)}')
print(f'Mean age (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f}')"}
